roads.name: Kennedy Home Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 9 curves in 4.1 miles.
From 43 to 54 ft, with 52 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.32 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.

roads.name: Lake Wilson Road
words: An easygoing road: 7 curves in 3.6 miles, with room to breathe between them.
From 112 to 148 ft, with 160 ft of up and down along the way.
Homes line much of it: about 44 buildings a mile beside the road.
17 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 45 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.55 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
